title: John Lennon buys a box guitar in Port of Spain, Trinidad | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono visited the National Arts and Crafts Exhibition in Port of Spain, Trinidad, on 30 April 1971.

The exhibition was at the Eastern Market, situated on George Street. While there, Lennon found an oversized box guitar which he wished to purchase. Finding no seller present, he left a SOLD tag on the instrument, and returned later on in the day to complete the sale.
